samples.name: character-citizen-male-1-sow-frame-1
samples.prompt: Exactly ONE young Slavic peasant in ONE seed-sowing pose. NOT a sprite sheet. Same character as first reference: short brown hair, belted kosovorotka, trousers, bast shoes. Other refs define simple Kenney Tiny pixel art. Transparent 16x16 logical pixel canvas enlarged nearest-neighbor, body centered, south-facing slight overhead view, feet bottom row, about 14 pixels tall. Strict chunky solid pixel clusters, no gradients, texture, antialiasing, glow, shadow, ground, text, extra people. Exact skin #f7c282/#e19a65, hair #bd6c4a/#763b36, clothes #c0cbdc/#8b9bb4/#52607c. A tiny tan seed pouch at waist supported by screen-left hand. Preparation: screen-right hand reaching into pouch at waist to gather seeds; elbows bent close to torso.
